analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: Trustpilot may transfer your personal data to third parties who enter into licensing agreements with us and to our partners for things like displaying personalised ads to you or to deliver improvements to our service.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Public Data Widely
analysis.quote: One of Trustpilot's goals is to maximise the visibility, availability, and utility of reviews and related content to the world. To do this we allow various independent third parties to access and use public personal data without limitation.

analysis.headline: AI Trained On Your Content
analysis.quote: In addition to individual consumer or business users of Trustpilot, such visitors might also include search engines and other entities (such as Google and OpenAI) which programmatically crawl web content to surface it in search results or use it for training their AI models.

analysis.headline: Collects Extensive User Data
analysis.quote: We may collect the following public and private personal data: User account information, Information about reviews and ratings, Social networks, Business account information, Contact information, Device and location information, Usage and profiling information, Your verification data, Preferences information, Communication information, Call recordings, Chrome extension data.

analysis.headline: Third-Parties Provide Your Data
analysis.quote: Sometimes we're given information about you from third parties. For example, when you sign up for a Trustpilot account via Facebook, your account is automatically pre-filled with the information we receive from them.

analysis.headline: Retains Data After Deletion
analysis.quote: If you delete your Trustpilot account, we retain certain information we are required by law or have compelling legitimate interests to keep.

analysis.headline: Your Rights Are Not Absolute
analysis.quote: Please note that the above rights are not absolute and might be limited. For example, we may not comply with your request if fulfilling it would reveal personal data about another person, or if you ask us to delete information which we are required by law, or have compelling legitimate interests, to keep.

analysis.headline: Email Security Not Guaranteed
analysis.quote: Emails sent via the platform may not be encrypted, and we therefore advise you not to include any confidential information in your emails to us.
